raw.title: Vior Naturals - Cherry Plum | Bach Flower Stock Concentrate - 10ml
raw.description: Fear of the mind being over-strained, of reason giving way. Bach Flower Cherry Plum

regression_note: Bare 'flower' used to match the smokable word list and misclassified Bach flower remedies (a completely unrelated herbal product category) as smokable cannabis. Fixed by requiring a cannabis qualifier before 'flower' counts (smokable list uses 'cannabis flower'/'hemp flower'/'cbd flower'/'infused flower', never bare 'flower'). This product correctly resolves to no form signal at all -> 'other', ambiguous=true, routed to category_uncertain review — not silently mis-tagged.
